The first 99 paths each have 10 commands. The last has 9 or 10. The root contributes exactly one GroupContiguous. Thus totals are 1000 and 1001. Use import origin (0,0), identity viewport and no extra opacity or transforms. Inspect the real parser plan; do not use this arithmetic as actual execution evidence.
